    Greenbrook Village

    Greenbrook Village is a community on purpose, dedicated to satisfied comfortable living. Within its neighborhoods, every buyer, whether a first-time purchase or retiree, can find the ideal home for themselves.

    Single-family homes & Townhomes

    1,200 - 4,200
    square feet

    $400s to
    $1M+

    Lots of family friendly spaces 

    About This Village

    Greenbrook Village offers "Green Neighborhoods." Here the homebuyer can choose an energy efficient, environmentally-friendly home. Beautiful lakes and nature preserves dot this series of neighborhoods. So many home options avail themselves to buyers; maintenance-free condominiums, villas, cottages, and townhomes. Single family and estate homes offer wonderful options to homebuyer needs.

    ​

    The Greenbrook Adventure Park invites recreational enthusiasts of all ages. Bike trails, a dog park, basketball court, and a playground beckons the young at heart. All this sits in some of the most beautiful nature landscapes Lakewood Ranch has to offer.

    Schools

    Grade School: Gilbert W. McNeal Elementary (8/10)

    Middle School: R. Dan Nolan Middle School (N/A)

    High School: Lakewood Ranch High (6/10)

    Residents in Greenbrook Village celebrate the outdoors. Enjoy scenic parks, walking and biking trails, multiple soccer fields, a baseball field, tennis courts, a volleyball court, an outdoor inline skating rink, and multiple playgrounds. Catch your breath at the pavillion and barbecue grills before heading to the basketball courts or time on the water kayaking. All this while conveniently located between SR70 and University Parkway with great access to schools and shopping.
